create_subdirectory_hint_tracker: create a SubdirectoryHintTracker instance with a working directory to lazily discover project context files
check_tool_call_load_hints: check a tool call and load subdirectory hint files like AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md from visited directories
extract_directories_from_args: extract directory paths from tool call arguments including path keys and shell commands
load_hints_for_directory: load hint files from a directory and return formatted context text truncated to 8000 characters
extract_paths_from_command: extract file path tokens from a shell command string for subdirectory hint discovery
